title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF ILOCOS SUR FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL APRIL THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF ILOCOS SUR FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL APRIL THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID.
title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất năm 1903 tại Tỉnh Ilocos Sur đến ngày 30 tháng 4 năm 1904 và quy định hoàn lại tiền phạt đã nộp
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายเวลาการชำระภาษีที่ดินปี1903ในจังหวัดอิโลโกส์ซูร์จนถึงวันที่30เมษายน1904และกำหนดการคืนค่าปรับที่ได้ชำระไปแล้ว
title.id: Undang-Undang yang Memperpanjang Waktu Pembayaran Pajak Tanah Tahun 1903 di Provinsi Ilocos Sur hingga 30 April 1904 serta Mengatur Pengembalian Denda yang Telah Dibayar
title.ms: Akta yang Memperluaskan Tempoh Bayaran Cukai Tanah Tahun 1903 di Wilayah Ilocos Sur sehingga 30 April 1904 dan Menetapkan Bayaran Balik Denda yang Telah Dibayar

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and
three m the Province of Ilocos Sur is herein extended to April thirtieth nineteen hundred and four anything in
previous Acts to the contrary notwithstanding. All penalties collected for the nonpayment of the land tax in
such province for the year nineteen hundred and three are hereby remitted, and the provincial treasurer of the
province mentioned above is authorized and directed to allow a rebate of the amount of such penalty to the
taxpayer upon whom the penalty was assessed, upon payment of his land tax for the year next

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage
Enacted, April 4, 1904.
